### EvryFlare Llama Noises??
One ordinary night on Discord, my good friend EvryFlare sent a video to the group chat where he made sounds he "didn't think were humanly possible." Those became four of the idle/ambient sounds, and over the next few days we worked to make a complete collection of preposterous noises for the poor Llamas. We even threw in an easter egg which shouldn't be too hard to find (:

Go ahead and toss this into your sibling's resource packs folder to prank them (of course hoping they don't keep their volume too high) or whatever else you want to do to satiate your trollish nature.

fllarma

---

### somewhat technical shenanigans

The pack format is 9, but you can ignore this as it should work in most modern versions anyway. If you encounter any issues, please reach out to me via Discord (@blokbustr) or wherever else.
